text:
NimbusLoop is a fast-growing fintech startup building modular payments and reconciliation APIs for small businesses. We move quickly, love clean abstractions, and are looking for a practical backend engineer to own features end-to-end and help scale our core services.

What you'll do
- Design and build reliable, testable backend services powering transaction processing and webhooks.
- Implement RESTful APIs, authentication, and data models used by our dashboard and partner integrations.
- Optimize database schemas and queries for performance and cost across high-volume workflows.
- Write automated tests, participate in code reviews, and improve CI/CD pipelines.
- Troubleshoot production issues, improve observability, and help define SLAs and runbooks.
- Collaborate with product and frontend teams to ship iterative improvements and API contracts.

What we need (mandatory)
- 2-5 years of professional experience as a backend engineer.
- Strong Node.js development experience.
- Hands-on experience with MongoDB.
- Experience building apps with Express.js.

Bonus points (preferred / good-to-have)
- Experience with Redis.
- Familiarity with React.

Location and work mode
Hybrid: Delhi NCR or Hyderabad, 3 days a week in the office.
